source_state_mutations.park: host cache entries/LRU/byte accounting/reuse buffers; copy running state/checkpoints/KV; sync; active state retained until switch

source_state_mutations.prefetch: staging pool/stream events/pending ordinal/count; active authoritative host prefix stays immutable
